part.text:
Fixed the bug in `bitposCommand` (src/bitops.c:927). While `bitcountCommand` already validated arguments before the key lookup, `bitposCommand` looked up the key first and returned `0`/`-1` for missing keys before ever parsing `start`/`end`/unit arguments — so invalid args like `bitpos missing 0 1 hello hello2` silently returned `0` instead of `ERR syntax error`.

The fix restructures `bitposCommand` to parse all arguments (bit, start, end, BIT/BYTE unit) before the key lookup, mirroring the `bitcountCommand` pattern. All `unit/bitops` tests now pass, including the previously failing "BITPOS will illegal arguments" and "BITPOS against non-integer value" cases.
